_comment: SESSION 23's SECOND SHALLOW ORDINAL. The user's claude_s14_gi13, turn 5, main-phase ordinal
FIVE -- and this one the recording already stamps `combo_off_verified: true`, rule WISH-DRAW,
on `Eldrazi Displacer: blink Peregrine Drake x60`. So it pins the strongest form: offered, and
the harness's own INDEPENDENT re-apply (TurnSolver::ApplyPlan, not a re-read of the gate's
flag) has to kill the opponent.
Board: Eldrazi Displacer + Peregrine Drake (untaps FIVE) over Yavimaya Coast carrying Trace of
Abundance, Aether Hub carrying Wild Growth AND Trace of Abundance, and a bare Conservatory as
the repeatable draw. The two auras share the Hub in the recording, and the order here is the
order that is LEGAL to have reached: Wild Growth first, then Trace -- Trace grants shroud, and
an Aura targets its host (CR 303.4a), so the reverse could never have been cast (CR 702.18a).
The Hub is staged with its energy counter, which is what makes it a {U}/{B} source at all --
rule WISH-DRAW's UB ingredient reads a conditional producer only while its condition holds.
This is also a live SEARCH shortfall (s14_gi13: human 5, search 6), which is why it is worth a
fixture rather than a line in a report: whatever a search shortcut does to this position, the
viewer's answer on it must not move.
